articles.title: Senate Dems should accept the victory they won on Trump's crypto limits: White House
articles.snippet: U.S. Senate Democrats got President Donald Trump to accept potential limits on his lucrative crypto dealings, but they say the Clarity Act's restrictions aren't enough.

articles.title: Clarity Act expected to miss its window before Congress' summer break, leadership says
articles.snippet: The deadline to get the crypto market structure bill done before senators scatter will likely be missed, says Majority Leader Thune, though it may get a start before then.

articles.title: Dem senator calls GOP’s CLARITY ethics proposal a ‘piece of s---’: Politico
articles.snippet: On Wednesday, Senate Republicans released the proposed text for the CLARITY Act, which has been met with pushback from Democrats regarding ethics provisions.

articles.title: Clarity Act on the Ropes as Ethics Fight and Shrinking Calendar Threaten Passage
articles.snippet: Senate Majority Leader John Thune signals the crypto market-structure bill likely won't clear the chamber before the August recess, as Democrats reject the GOP's ethics language and analysts slash the odds of passage.

articles.title: Nvidia, Meta, and Microsoft Tell Washington: Don't Kill Open-Source AI
articles.snippet: Twenty-five companies signed a letter defending open-weight models days after a Chinese AI helped Hugging Face survive a hack triggered by OpenAI's own systems.
